#1 Hidden Cause of Flock Health and Egg Problems


Hi! My name is Dr. Henley – A licensed veterinarian specialising in chicken health for over 14 years.


Chicken keeping is hard. Really hard.


One day your girls can look healthy…


The next? Lethargic, lay barely any eggs, and have a dirty vent no butt bath could get rid of.

Here’s What My Patients Use To Actually Keep Parasites Away:


In chickens, there’s this one thing that controls everything: Their gut.


When it’s in perfect condition, your flock is healthy - lots of healthy eggs, thick feathers, and clean butts.


When stressed, parasites attach to the gut lining and steal nutrients meant for your chickens.


Studies show 80-90% of backyard chickens have parasites right now.


By the time you see poopy butts or egg drops, they've been stealing nutrients for 4-8 weeks.


And spring is when parasites thrive the most in chickens. It’s unfortunately going to get worse.


Most solutions? They only scratch the surface.


❌ Butt baths - won't fix internal gut damage

❌ Garlic water - breaks down in hours, zero effect

❌ Pumpkin seeds - dose 500x too low

❌ Chemical dewormers - kill parasites but don't heal gut (and most chicken keepers hate the egg withdrawal)


You need to kill parasites and heal the gut at the same time.


Luckily, there is one simple solution that you can give to your precious hens right now…

Here’s What I Recommend To My Patients:


Roosty’s Flock Armor - after 14 years, I realised this is the best natural formula to support the hens’ guts & keep parasites away. Here’s why:


It includes chilli - a spice chickens can't taste, but parasites can't stand.


The parasites are literally flushed out of their bodies and released in the chicken’s poop.


Oregano + garlic protect their gut from stress, inflammation, and any future health problems.


Roosty’s is vet-approved, used by 300,000 customers in the US, and rated 4.6 stars across thousands of reviews.


And the best part? No egg withdrawal. You can eat eggs the same day.
